subject: Priority check & next steps for Redwood pilot / Catalyst Apps
content:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara@catalystapps.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jul 2025 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Intro & quick recap — Redwood demo + mutual action plan

Hi Sara / Matt,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the thoughtful questions and the clarity on where Catalyst is trying to reduce inference cost for realtime features. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary of discovery (what I heard)
- Goal: reduce per-token inference cost and latency for recommendation chat widget; targeted 50% cost reduction while keeping median latency under 150ms.
- Workload: mixed short prompts (~40 tokens) with occasional long context retrieval (~1k tokens).
- Decision-makers: Sara (PM), Matt (CTO), plus procurement for final approval.
- Timeline: ideal pilot kickoff in July, production decision in early September (Q3 decision).
- Budget: rough target $60k–$90k for pilot+initial production capacity.

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP)
1) Redwood provides a 4-week pilot: dedicated instance with a cost-optimized model profile, access to console dashboards, and a short eval suite.
2) We’ll deliver a PoC plan + SOW draft by Friday (attached).
3) Catalyst provides sample traffic profile and a short list of success metrics (latency, cost/req, error rate).
4) Week 4: review results and decision checkpoint — go/no-go.

Attachments included: redwood-pricing-2025.pdf; redwood-poc-plan.docx; demo-recording-20250701.mp4

As next steps, can you confirm: (a) that Matt and procurement are available for a 20–30m alignment call next week, and (b) whether the July kickoff window is still preferred? If July looks tight, we can push the pilot start to early August but I wanted to check priority ahead of the quarter.

If it helps, we can also surface a short pilot credit to reduce up-front friction — I’ll coordinate with Dev and Sean if that would help.

Thanks —
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[aisha_rahman@redwood.ai] | +1 (415) 555-0198

--

From: Sara Liu <sara@catalystapps.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Matt Heaney <matt.heaney@catalystapps.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jul 2025 09:14:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro & quick recap — Redwood demo + mutual action plan

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the tidy recap — this is helpful. We are generally aligned on the goals. A few quick asks from our side: 
- Could you include a brief section in the SOW about data handling/residency? We have some EU data routing constraints for a slice of our logs.
- Procurement will need the final pricing SOW + standard security questionnaire.

Matt is available Tue next week for a 30m sync, I’ll loop procurement in once we have the SOW. Appreciate the offer of a pilot credit — that could make the internal ask easier.

Best,
Sara
Principal Product Manager | Catalyst Apps

On Thu, Jul 3, 2025 at 9:20 AM Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Got it — I’ll add a short Data Handling addendum and include our SOC2 summary and expected network routing options. I’ll drop the SOW by Friday.
>
> — Aisha

--

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara@catalystapps.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Quick check — priority and timing for pilot (July → Q3?)

Hi Sara / Matt,

Wanted to resurface this thread — we sent the SOW and data addendum on Friday (attached) but haven’t heard back; wanted to check whether the pilot is still a July priority on your side with Q3 decision timing. Two quick options if priorities shifted:

Option A — keep July kickoff: we can fast-track and provide a 2-week credit toward the pilot to reduce up-front cost.
Option B — move kickoff to early Aug / Sept: we’ll reserve a pilot slot and tailor the onboarding plan to your preferred timing.

Short ask: is the pilot still on track for Q3? If approvals/budget are delayed, we’ll adapt the schedule — just trying to understand whether this is still high priority as you close the quarter.

If easier, reply with a one-line status update and I’ll handle the follow-up with procurement.

Thanks —
Aisha
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: pilot-offer.pdf (PDF, 18KB)]

--

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Quick check — priority and timing for pilot (July → Q3?)

Aisha / Sean,

If Catalyst signals that budget is slipping, my suggestion is to offer a constrained pilot credit structure rather than a full discount: 30% credit on infra costs for the first 2 weeks + one week extended onboarding support at no charge. This keeps skin in the game on both sides and is quick to approve.

Two tactical notes you can include in your follow-up to Sara: 
- Call out the SOC2 and the data routing options we’ve attached (they asked about residency).
- Offer a short success metric template we’ll use for the Week 4 review (latency P50/P95, cost per thousand tokens, error rate).

If you want, I can pre-draft the approval note for finance so we can move quickly if they accept.

— Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
